theater: 伊庇魯斯南部菲尼刻與莫洛西亞

battle.name: 伊利里亞人入侵伊庇魯斯
battle.theater: 伊庇魯斯南部菲尼刻與莫洛西亞
battle.brief: 公元前385年，伊利里亞聯軍趁西希臘無暇西顧，渡海侵入伊庇魯斯，在菲尼刻擊潰莫洛西亞重裝步兵並攻陷城邑，把大批俘虜與物資裝船運走。卡面上的斯巴達長矛正是莫洛西亞方陣的制式長矛；十餘年後馬其頓改用薩里沙，這類兩米長矛便退居配角。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 公元前385年的伊庇魯斯，成了亞得里亞海東岸勢力與希臘城邦世界正面碰撞的地方。交戰一方並非單一國家，而是以亞得里亞東岸的奧托阿里亞泰、達奧爾西與瓦拉尼等部族拼成的伊利里亞聯軍，軍權集中於一位王，Justin 的摘要稱其名為格拉波斯，後世考證則常把這次遠征與巴爾狄利斯治下的阿爾迪亞埃聯盟連在一起。聯軍以善於奔襲的輕裝步兵為主，配輕騎，另有速度極快的小型帆船「連姆比」把劫掠者分批送上伊庇魯斯海岸，船上即是全部糧秣與攻城器材。另一方是莫洛西亞王國，即伊庇魯斯北部莫洛西人的國家，國王阿里巴斯在位，王都以多多納為宗教與政治核心，南部重鎮菲尼刻是查奧尼人與莫洛西人共管的港城，也是王國對外貿易與穀物輸出的門戶。此時西希臘無力介入：斯巴達王阿格西勞斯遠征亞洲，雅典在科林斯戰爭之後重整海軍，馬其頓則正忙著整合馬其頓盆地，沒有一方及時出兵西面，聯軍於是放手深入。戰爭的本質，是亞得里亞海東岸聯盟試探希臘西端權力真空的一次掠奪性遠征。
countriesEn: The year 385 BC set the western edge of the Greek world against the peoples of the eastern Adriatic. On one side stood no single state, but an Illyrian confederacy assembled from tribes such as the Autariatae, the Daorsi and the Varani of the eastern Adriatic coast, with command centred on a single king whom Justin's epitome names Grabos, while modern scholarship often links the raid to the Ardyaei confederacy under Bardylis. The confederacy's backbone was fast-moving light infantry, supported by light cavalry and by a flotilla of small, fast sailing craft, the lembi, which carried raiders to the coast of Epirus in successive waves, the ships themselves serving as the entire supply train and carrying the siege equipment. The other side was the Molossian kingdom, the state of the Molossians in northern Epirus, ruled by King Arybbas, with Dodona as its religious and political centre and Phoenice, the harbour city held jointly by the Chaonians and the Molossians, as its southern stronghold and the point through which the kingdom exported grain and other goods. The rest of the Greek world had no capacity to intervene: the Spartan king Agesilaus was campaigning in Asia, Athens was rebuilding its fleet after the Corinthian War, and Macedonia was absorbed in the work of its own consolidation. Nobody moved to defend Epirus, and the confederacy was free to strike deep. In essence the war was a predatory expedition by an eastern Adriatic league into a power vacuum at the western end of the Greek world.
people: 這場戰爭留下名字的人不多，但留下的每一個都關係到一國的存亡。伊利里亞方面，聯盟統帥掌握任免各部族頭目、決定遠征與撤軍的權力；史家記他攻下菲尼刻之後，把大批俘虜與貨物重新裝船，同時任由各部族首領瓜分戰利品，這種分配方式也決定了遠征不會變成長期佔領。與他直接交鋒的是莫洛西亞王國的國王阿里巴斯，約公元前400年至370年在位，執政期間把多多納的醫神聖所擴建成王國最大的宗教建築群，並把王國勢力向菲尼刻與阿姆布拉希亞延伸。戰敗之後他退守多多納與山區堡塞，軍隊主力潰散、菲尼刻守軍被俘，南境與海路一度盡失，國勢需要多年才重新站穩。古代記載提到莫洛西亞人曾向雅典與斯巴達求援，但兩強各自有事，援助沒有成形，聯盟內部的爭執與猜疑則隨著撤退而擴大。菲尼刻的查奧尼人與莫洛西人雖然共處一城，在危急時是否共同作戰，事後的記載並不一致，這正是聯盟挑選南境下手的原因。
peopleEn: Few individuals from this war are named in the sources, but each of them mattered to the survival of a state. On the Illyrian side, the confederate commander held the authority to appoint the chiefs of the contributing tribes and to decide when the expedition would advance and when it would withdraw; the epitome records that after taking Phoenice he re-loaded the captives and the goods onto his ships and let the tribal leaders divide the plunder, and that mode of distribution is precisely why the raid did not turn into a lasting occupation. His opposite number was Arybbas, king of the Molossians, who ruled from roughly 400 to 370 BC. During his reign he enlarged the sanctuary of Asclepius at Dodona into the largest religious complex of the kingdom and extended royal authority towards Phoenice and Ambracia. After the defeat he withdrew to Dodona and the mountain fortresses; his main force dissolved, the garrison of Phoenice was taken prisoner, the southern districts and the sea route were lost for a time, and the kingdom needed years to recover its footing. Ancient accounts state that the Molossians appealed to Athens and Sparta for help, but both powers had their own preoccupations and no assistance materialised, while quarrels and suspicion inside the league widened as the expedition withdrew. The Chaonians and the Molossians shared Phoenice, but the record does not agree on whether they fought together in the crisis, which was part of why the raiders picked the southern city as their target.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛，學名 dory，是公元前五至四世紀希臘重裝步兵的制式長矛：白蠻木或白楊木的桿身，長約兩米，前端裝鐵矛頭，尾端套一截青銅矛尾套，必要時可以插地支撐身體、再順勢後撤拔起，不必像後來某些長矛兵那樣把長矛倒插入囊。配上方形重步兵的圓盾 aspis、亞麻或皮製胸甲、頭盔與脛甲，這就是莫洛西亞重步兵在菲尼刻城下排開方陣時的裝備。莫洛西亞是希臘語族埃托利亞方言的國家，軍制直接承襲南部希臘的重裝步兵傳統；馬其頓的薩里沙長矛改革要到公元前四世紀中葉才出現，公元前385年的方陣裡站著的仍是這類兩米長矛。伊利里亞聯軍的裝備路線完全不同：步兵多不穿重甲，用大型橢圓藤牌，藤條編織再蒙牛皮，長及膝下，配短矛、輕標槍與投石索，近身用短劍；騎兵輕裝，來去如電；船隊用小而快的帆船，人數不多，卻可以反覆把人送上岸。攻城方面沒有重型攻城塔與撞錘留下記載，推測以火攻、繩梯攀牆與內應配合為主，攻城器械很可能就地取自菲尼刻與周邊村落。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Spartan dory, the standard spear of Greek hoplites in the fifth and fourth centuries BC: a shaft of ash or poplar about two metres long, with an iron head at the front and a bronze butt-cap at the rear, which could be planted in the ground to support the body and then withdrawn in the same motion, so that the spear did not have to be reversed and shouldered the way later sarissa pikemen did. Together with the round aspis, a linen or leather corselet, a helmet and greaves, this was the equipment with which Molossian heavy infantry drew up in phalanx below the walls of Phoenice. The Molossian state spoke an Aeolic dialect of Greek and its military system inherited the heavy infantry tradition of southern Greece directly; the Macedonian sarissa reform did not appear until the middle of the fourth century, so the phalanx of 385 BC still carried this two-metre spear. The Illyrian confederacy followed an entirely different equipment path: most of its infantry wore no body armour, carried large oblong shields of wicker covered with ox-hide that reached below the knee, and used short spears, light javelins and slings, with short swords for the final exchange. Its cavalry was light and fast, and its ships were small and quick, so that men could be landed repeatedly rather than in a single mass. No heavy siege tower or battering ram is recorded for the assault, so the walls were probably taken with fire, rope ladders and help from inside the city, the tools being taken from Phoenice and the surrounding villages.
tactics: 伊利里亞聯軍的戰法是典型的海盜式登岸作戰：小舟在夜裡或晨霧中靠岸，輕裝步兵先散開成鬆散的線，用標槍與投石索覆蓋城郊道路，騎兵沿平原邊緣掠奪側翼，等希臘方陣的銳氣被消耗、陣形被地形切斷之後，主力才壓上去。波利比烏斯在描述後世伊利里亞與色雷斯援軍時說過他們的套路：先跑幾步把長矛擲出，再趁隙突進，避開與密集盾牌的正面撞擊。莫洛西亞方的應對則是傳統重步兵方陣：以縱隊為單位層層疊進，長矛前伸、盾緣重疊，弓箭與標槍覆蓋隊形前方，騎兵與投射兵在兩翼掩護。第一線一旦被標槍削弱、又被側翼騎兵牽制，重步兵的推進速度會迅速下降，陣角的缺口就成為聯軍真正的突破口。菲尼刻的地形對守方不利：城築在沃索河入海口東岸的台地上，山下有海門與小港，沼澤與梯田把平原切成狹長通道；攻城方只要封住港口，守方就沒有退往海上的路，而城內可用的備援、糧食與反攻城器材都很有限。補給方面，聯軍沒有固定補給線，糧食全靠就地掠奪與船上攜帶，這種戰爭形式注定不能持久，但足以支撐一次攻城的耗費。
tacticsEn: The confederacy fought in the typical manner of raiders from the sea. Small craft came ashore in the night or in the morning mist; light infantry spread out in a loose line and swept the roads outside the city with javelins and slings, while cavalry worked along the edge of the plain and took the flanks; only after the Greek phalanx had been worn down by missiles and broken up by the ground was the main body pressed forward. Polybius, describing the Illyrian and Thracian auxiliaries of a later campaign, sets out their method: they run up a few paces, throw their long spears, and close on the gap, avoiding a direct impact against a dense wall of shields. The Molossian answer was the traditional heavy infantry phalanx, organised in companies and ranked in depth, with the dories extended and the shield rims overlapping, archers and javelin-men covering the front, and cavalry and light troops protecting the flanks. Once the first rank had been thinned by missiles and held in check by cavalry on the flank, the heavy infantry could not regain its momentum, and the gap at the corner of the formation became the real breach through which the raiders entered. The ground at Phoenice did not favour the defenders. The city stood on a terrace above the mouth of the Vjosa on the eastern side of the bay, with a sea gate and a small harbour below it; marshes and terraced slopes cut the plain into narrow lanes, and once the besiegers sealed the harbour there was no way out to the sea, while the reserves, the food and the counter-siege materials within the walls were limited. On the Illyrian side there was no fixed supply line at all: food was taken from the country as it was plundered and carried on the ships, a form of warfare that could not be sustained for long but was more than sufficient to pay the cost of one siege.
data: 可核對的數字不多，而且彼此的可靠程度相差很大。戰役年份是公元前385年，這一點古代摘要與現代年表一致；具體月份無從考證，只能按亞得里亞海的航行季節（夏末至初秋）推斷，本卡記作九月。波利比烏斯在第二卷追述伊利里亞人劫掠菲尼刻時記載，掠奪中擄走約十五萬人，Justin 的摘要沿用並誇大此說；今日學界普遍視為文學化的數字，但可以確定的是，菲尼刻連同其腹地的穀物、牲畜與港口貨運被系統性地帶走，遠征的規模確實超出一般劫掠。艦隊方面，古代記載提到伊利里亞人使用數百艘輕舟，各抄本所載約數不一，常見者為兩百艘上下；這正是理解海盜式遠征的關鍵，人可以分批抵岸，撤退時也可以分批離開，不必等待全軍集結。遠征的兵員數沒有可靠記載；最常被引用的十五萬是俘虜數而不是兵員數，按部族聯盟的徵召能力推估，參戰兵力大致在數千至一萬之間。距離方面，菲尼刻的港口在山下海灣，攻城方自登陸處到城牆約一至兩公里，繞城東北方向的牆線依台地延伸數百公尺。損失方面，菲尼刻守軍全數被俘或潰散，莫洛西亞王國失去南境與對外通道；聯軍方面的損失沒有任何記載，反映整場戰役幾乎沒有遇到有效阻擊。
dataEn: Few of the figures can be checked, and their reliability varies a great deal. The date of the campaign, 385 BC, is agreed between the ancient epitomes and modern chronologies. The month is not recorded and can only be inferred from the sailing season of the Adriatic, late summer to early autumn, so the card records it as September. In Book 2, where Polybius recalls the Illyrian sack of Phoenice, the plunder is said to have yielded about one hundred and fifty thousand captives, a figure repeated and inflated by Justin's epitome. Modern scholarship generally treats it as a literary number, but what can be established is that Phoenice together with the grain, the livestock and the port traffic of its hinterland was carried off in a systematic way, and that the scale of the raid exceeded that of ordinary piracy. On the fleet, the ancient sources speak of several hundred light vessels, the numbers differing between manuscripts, with two hundred or so the usual figure; this is the key to understanding a raid of this kind, since men could be landed in successive waves and could leave in successive waves without waiting for the whole force to reassemble. The number of men committed is nowhere recorded. The one hundred and fifty thousand most often quoted is a count of captives, not of soldiers; on any reasonable estimate of the mustering capacity of a tribal league, the force that took part was in the order of several thousand to perhaps ten thousand. In distance terms, the harbour of Phoenice lay below the city, and from the landing place to the walls is about one to two kilometres, while the wall line to the north-east follows the terrace for several hundred metres. On losses, the garrison of Phoenice was wholly taken or scattered and the Molossian kingdom lost its southern provinces and its outward route; no losses at all are recorded for the confederacy, which shows that the whole operation met with almost no effective resistance.
cause: 伊利里亞聯軍遠征伊庇魯斯，有遠因也有近因。遠因是亞得里亞海東岸部族的整合與南下：奧托阿里亞泰、達奧爾西、瓦拉尼等部族在同一王或王系之下結盟，而越過亞得里亞海的航線控制，成為聯盟財政與聲望的主要來源。對聯盟內部沒有農業盈餘的部落而言，劫掠是季節性的大宗收入，小船隊使他們可以把小批量、快速、不留痕跡的掠奪做到數百公里之外。近因是西希臘的權力真空：雅典在公元前424年阿姆布拉科斯灣方向的敗北之後，失去了亞得里亞海西岸的據點；科林斯戰爭與其後的蕭條又抽空了希臘城邦的餘力，斯巴達的注意力在亞洲，馬其頓正忙著整合馬其頓盆地，沒有聯盟國家準備為菲尼刻出兵。莫洛西亞王國自身也不具備抵抗縱深遠征的實力：它能召喚的重裝步兵足以守城，卻沒有足夠的騎兵與投射兵種在開闊地上與海盜式登岸的敵人周旋，國庫與港口的收入遠不如陸上強鄰。最後，菲尼刻本身提供了一切誘因：可登陸的灣、連接內陸谷地的道路、囤積的穀物與作坊，以及一座防衛尚可但並不牢固的城。
causeEn: The expedition of the Illyrian confederacy into Epirus had both remote and immediate causes. The remote cause was the consolidation and southward reach of the tribes of the eastern Adriatic: the Autariatae, the Daorsi and the Varani were bound together under one king or one royal line, and control of the shipping lanes across the Adriatic had become the league's main source of wealth and of standing. For tribes with little agricultural surplus, plunder was a seasonal bulk income, and the small flotilla allowed them to carry out small, fast, deniable raids hundreds of kilometres away. The immediate cause was the power vacuum in the western Greek world. After its reverse at the Ambracian Gulf in 424 BC, Athens had lost its footholds on the western side of the Adriatic, and the Corinthian War and the depression that followed drained the reserves of the Greek city-states. Sparta was absorbed in Asia, Macedonia was busy consolidating the Macedonian plain, and no league had prepared to send troops to Phoenice. The Molossian kingdom itself lacked the strength to resist a deep expedition: it could muster hoplites enough to hold a city, but it had neither the cavalry nor the missile troops needed to manoeuvre on open ground against an enemy landing from the sea, and its revenues and its ports were far inferior to those of its powerful land neighbour. In the end Phoenice offered every inducement: a bay that could be landed in, a road into the inland valley, stored grain and workshops, and a city that was defensible but not impregnable.
impact: 這場戰爭的餘波長過戰役本身。對莫洛西亞王國而言，南方重鎮與海路同時失守，經濟重心被迫退到多多納與內陸谷地，軍隊在數年之內需要重整，南境一度淪為外來勢力可隨時再取的目標；伊庇魯斯在希臘世界中的政治分量因此下滑，雅典與亞爾戈斯那些針對西希臘的干預計畫，也就失去了落腳點。對亞得里亞海整體而言，聯盟以一次成功的實戰掠奪證明了小國海盜式軍隊足以劫掠富庶的希臘城邦與其附屬盟邦的港城，此後伊利里亞的劫掠越過亞得里亞海向西擴張，航路與西地中海的商業網開始受到牽動，這條線索最終把羅馬拖進亞得里亞海——公元前229年的第一次伊利里亞戰爭，正是這類劫掠累積而成的政治危機。兵器史上的位置更為清晰：公元前385年之後十餘年，馬其頓在腓力二世手裡完成了長矛與混合方陣的改革，薩里沙長矛與大量投射兵種取代了重步兵的長矛；卡面這件斯巴達長矛因而是方陣長矛時代的最後一環，它在這場戰爭裡仍然站在前排，往後則被推去側翼，隨希臘化將軍的方陣一同退場。
impactEn: The consequences of this war outlasted the campaign itself. For the Molossian kingdom, the loss of its southern stronghold and of the sea route at the same time pushed the economic centre of the state back to Dodona and to the inland valleys; the army had to be rebuilt over several years, and the south became a target a foreign power could take again at will. Epirus therefore lost political weight in the Greek world, and the plans of intervention in the west that Athens and Argos had been entertaining lost their point of contact. For the Adriatic as a whole, the confederacy had proved with a single successful raid that a small state of raiders could sack wealthy Greek cities and the ports of their subject allies, and Illyrian plundering began to extend westward across the Adriatic, interfering with the trading network of the western Mediterranean. That thread eventually pulled Rome into the Adriatic: the First Illyrian War of 229 BC was the political crisis produced by the accumulation of this kind of piracy. The place of the weapon in military history is even clearer. Within a little over ten years of 385 BC, Macedonia under Philip II completed the reform of the spear and of the combined phalanx, and the sarissa together with a mass of missile troops displaced the hoplite's dory. The Spartan spear on this card is therefore the last link in the age of the phalanx spear: it still stood in the front rank in this war, and was afterwards pushed out to the flank, retiring from the field along with the phalanx of the Hellenistic generals.
result: 結果是菲尼刻陷落。攻城方以封海、斷路、壓制的方式耗盡守方，破了城，守軍被俘，港口與腹地的物資被搬上船；莫洛西亞王國沒有被滅國，阿里巴斯退守多多納與山區堡塞，國家主體仍在，但喪失了南部與海路，一度淪為伊利里亞聯盟眼裡的貢賦來源。聯軍沒有留下駐防，也沒有建立傀儡政權，帶著戰利品與俘虜沿原路退回，把這次遠征定義為一次掠奪而不是征服。對伊庇魯斯而言，短期最直接的後果是安全與主權的尊嚴受損，長期則是區域局勢的倒轉：幾年後的公元前359至358年，馬其頓王腓力二世兩度擊敗並殺死巴爾狄利斯，拆散聯盟，伊利里亞人自此再不能單獨決定西希臘的命運。而伊利里亞的海上實力並未消失，它轉而西進，終於在公元前229年與羅馬正面碰撞，成為亞得里亞海歷史的分水嶺。
resultEn: The result was the fall of Phoenice. The besiegers spent the defenders down by sealing the sea, cutting the roads and wearing out the garrison, and then broke into the city; the garrison was taken prisoner and the goods of the harbour and of the hinterland were carried onto the ships. The Molossian kingdom was not destroyed: Arybbas withdrew to Dodona and the mountain fortresses and the body of the state survived, but the south and the sea route were gone, and for a time the kingdom looked like a source of tribute to the Illyrian league. The confederacy left neither a garrison nor a puppet regime; it took its plunder and its captives back along the road it had come, and defined the expedition as a raid rather than a conquest. For Epirus the immediate consequence was loss of security and of the standing of its sovereignty; in the long run the regional balance was reversed. Within a few years, in 359 and 358 BC, Philip II of Macedon defeated Bardylis twice and killed him, breaking up the league, and from then on the Illyrians could no longer decide the fate of the western Greek world on their own. Their maritime strength did not disappear, however; it turned westward and eventually collided with Rome in 229 BC, which became the watershed in the history of the Adriatic.
